name: applePushCertificate
description: Apple MDM push certificate with its expiry, needed to manage iOS, iPadOS and macOS devices

metadata.name: health
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const t = new Date($['expirationDateTime']).getTime(); if (!$['expirationDateTime'] || isNaN(t)) { return 'Unknown'; } const days = (t - Date.now()) / 86400000; return days < 0 ? 'Expired' : days <= 30 ? 'Expiring soon' : 'Valid'; })() }}

metadata.name: daysUntilExpiry
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const t = new Date($['expirationDateTime']).getTime(); return !$['expirationDateTime'] || isNaN(t) ? null : Math.floor((t - Date.now()) / 86400000); })() }}
